title: Photo of the Dave Bartholomew band at the opening of the Pelican
summary: Harris mentions a picture of the Bartholomew band, taken when Dave was sick the night they opened the Pelican nightclub.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: And I have a picture of when I was with Dave Bartholomew. I have a picture up in the book up there. Of the whole band?
Dave was sick that night. He didn't come out that night. But at the time we opened up the old Pelican nightclub. Oh, on Rambart Street. Rambart Street, yeah. Yeah.
